q: days 1-4 went really well. She started self initiating by second half of day 1 and she had NO accidents on day 4! I thought this was it! […] Then on day 5 I had to go back to work. It was her first day back with the nanny

q: But I noticed on the camera later that my poor baby was trying to tell her she needed to go and was by the potty (she was wearing pants and doesnt know how to take it off yet), the nanny was busy doing dishes or something so she didn’t hear.

q: She peed 22 times throughout the whole day and basically all accidents!

q: Please no comments about how she isn’t ready because she is, she was self initiating very reliably up until the day with the nanny.

q: I'm just kicking myself for not taking the day off on Monday to prevent this but no use crying over spilt milk.

q:
Im a single solo mom 

I work full time remote and have my son with me 100% of the time.
